comment: Load Tip on an .abr opens a chooser and loads the tip picked. Load Tip in the Tool Options docker opens the file picker, which is answered with the version 6 fixture, and the chooser lists its three tips by name. A click on the second, Left Half, writes it into the saved tips folder as a .png and loads it, a vertical stroke paints the left half of each dab and not the right, and a preset saved with it reopens on Left Half and paints the same. Last, a preset naming a tip not on disk says so in the Tip Image row.
1, Load Tip pressed, the picker answered with the version 6 collection: the chooser lists Dry Disc, Left Half and Deep Ramp, each a cell with its picture and its name.
2, a click on the second cell: Left Half is written into the saved tips folder and loaded, the chooser closed and the Tip Image grid framing it.
3, a vertical stroke at x 500: the left half of every dab paints, so x 470 is covered and x 530 is not.
4, saved as a preset, the tip moved to the procedural disc, and the preset loaded again: the Tip Image row is back on Left Half, and a stroke at x 900 paints the same.
5, a preset naming a tip the tips folder does not hold, as one saved on another machine: the Tip Image row marks the tip unreadable and its tooltip says the file is not on disk.
